versions.content: DRAFT When entering the PNC sub state COMM_PNC_REQUESTED from COMM_PNC_NO_COM or COMM_PNC_PREPARE_SLEEP, and ComMPncWakeupSleepRequestEnabled of this PNC is set to TRUE , BswM_ComM_CurrentPNCMode shall be called with COMM_PNC_REQUESTED_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST , instead of calling BswM _ComM_CurrentPNCMode with COMM_PNC_REQUESTED .
